button.label: Title
button.screentip: Format selected text as paper title

button.label: Subtitle
button.screentip: Format selected text as paper subtitle (optional)

button.label: Author
button.screentip: Format selected text as paper author(s)

button.label: ORCID
button.screentip: Format selected text as ORCID id
button.supertip: Please note that ORCID ids will not be printed. In the online version they will be replaced by icons that are linked to the related ORCID pages.

button.label: Address
button.screentip: Format selected text as affiliation (including e-mail address, URL)

button.label: E-mail
button.screentip: Format selected text as e-mail address or URL (apply typewriter style)

button.label: Abstract
button.screentip: Format selected text as abstract
button.supertip: If not present, the word 'Abstract' is added at the beginning of the first paragraph.

button.label: Keywords
button.screentip: Format selected text as keywords
button.supertip: If not present, the word 'Keywords' is added at the beginning of the first paragraph.

button.label: H1
button.screentip: Format selected text as heading (level 1)

button.label: H2
button.screentip: Format selected text as heading (level 2)

button.label: H3
button.screentip: Format selected text as an unnumbered heading (level 3)

button.label: H4
button.screentip: Format selected text as an unnumbered heading (level 4)

button.label: Bullet Item
button.screentip: Format selected text as bullet item(s)
button.supertip: Please note that bullets are the default for unnumbered lists in Springer proceedings.

button.label: Dash Item
button.screentip: Format selected text as dash item(s)
button.supertip: Please note that bullets are the default for unnumbered lists in Springer proceedings.

button.label: Num Item
button.screentip: Format selected text as numbered item(s)

button.label: List Level +
button.screentip: Move the selected text one level up in the list hierarchy
button.supertip: This buttton can be used to create and edit nested lists (numbered and unnumbered).

button.label: List Level -
button.screentip: Move the selected text one level down in the list hierarchy
button.supertip: This buttton can be used to create and edit nested lists (numbered and unnumbered).

button.label: 1../..n..
button.screentip: Toggle between restarting and continuing a numbered list

button.label: Normal Text
button.screentip: Format the selection as normal text
button.supertip: This button can change both paragraph format and character style. If applied to a nonstandard paragraph, the standard paragraph format is applied. If applied to a standard paragraph, the standard character style is applied. If you want to both apply the standard paragraph format and remove a nonstandard character style, simply click on the button twice.

button.label: Add Space
button.screentip: Add 6 pt (2.1 mm) of vertical space before the selected paragraph.

button.label: Clear Space
button.screentip: Clear any vertical space before and after the selected text

button.label: Footnote
button.screentip: Add a footnote

button.label: Reference Item
button.screentip: Format selected text as reference item

button.label: Insert Image
button.screentip: Insert an image from a file.

button.label: Figure Caption
button.screentip: Format the selected text as figure caption
button.supertip: Please note that the figure is numbered with an automatic counter that is updated whenever you reopen the document. A figure caption should always be positioned below the related figure.

button.label: Table Caption
button.screentip: Format the selected text as table caption
button.supertip: Please note that the table is numbered with an automatic counter that is updated whenever you reopen the document. A table caption should always be positioned above the related table.

button.label: Displayed Equation
button.screentip: Format the selected text as a displayed equation

button.label: Add Eq. Number
button.screentip: Add an equation number to a selected equation
button.supertip: The equation numbering is updated whenever you open the document

button.label: Prog. Code
button.screentip: Format the selected text as program code (typewriter style)

button.label: Check Styles
button.screentip: Restore all styles
button.supertip: Use this button if the original template styles might have been altered or deleted.
